notes:
v0.6.35: fix ReticulumHF launcher link + bootstrap creates .setup_complete.

Two issues on a fresh image:

1. The launcher's "ReticulumHF" link at the bottom of the page
   pointed to http://<host>:8080/status — but :8080 is not
   listening on a fresh reticulumpi (only :80 has the wizard).
   Clicking the link was a silent no-op.

2. freedvtnc2.service has ConditionPathExists=!/etc/reticulumhf/
   .setup_complete — without that file, the unit is always
   skipped with "unmet condition check". The ReticulumHF wizard
   creates the file when its setup flow finishes, but the
   bootstrap never runs the wizard. So even with the right
   AUDIO_CARD, freedvtnc2.service never starts.

Fix:
- Launcher template: ReticulumHF link :8080/status → :80/ (the
  wizard's setup page)
- Bootstrap: sudo touch /etc/reticulumhf/.setup_complete after
  copying config.env, so freedvtnc2.service starts with the
  bootstrap's defaults. Operator can `sudo rm ! .setup_complete`
  to re-run the wizard.

Effect: clicking the ReticulumHF link now opens the wizard
where the operator can re-pick their radio (which sets
AUDIO_CARD correctly). After wizard completion,
freedvtnc2.service starts. Without the wizard, freedvtnc2
also starts using the bootstrap's defaults.
